prompt_en: A photograph of a mecha subject on the exposed bed of a vanished inland sea. As a mechanical structure, a giant mechanical walker stands beside a stranded survey buoy, the mechanical subject is visibly present as a coherent physical structure with a broad torso, articulated arms and heavy legs planted on cracked salt. The machine's own left shoulder carries a broad rectangular shield plate while its right shoulder has a smaller rounded shell; both shoulders remain attached to one torso. The two exposed shoulder-to-torso junctions flank the open central cockpit and are visible together, the contrasting armor shapes readable at the same depth. Its chest hatch is open toward the camera, revealing a human pilot seated inside the torso. Use the supplied portrait as the pilot's facial and hair appearance reference. The pilot has a short dark brown bob, wispy separated bangs, brown eyes and softly rounded facial contours. Her face remains individually recognizable through the dusty cockpit opening. She wears a practical faded rust flight suit, its collar loosened at the throat, with a lap harness resting across her hips. Her left forearm rests on the open sill and her right hand holds a small paper route map against her thigh. Both knees remain inside the seat bay, her boots supported by its floor. She looks past the camera toward the buoy, lips slightly parted, catching her breath in the still heat. A white salt tideline high on the walker's shin and the buoy's flaking shell make the lost water level visible. The hatch rim, seated figure and broad machine shoulder form one connected silhouette. Photograph from a nearby maintenance platform level with the cockpit, an almost frontal three-quarter exterior view wide enough to show both shoulder joints, the torso and a full near leg reaching the ground. Clear late-afternoon light warms her cheek and the worn steel while the far salt flats dissolve into pale haze; restrained analog color, tactile paint abrasion and quiet expeditionary intimacy. A high-resolution landscape photograph keeps the human face, hatch rim and both shoulder attachments in clear focus.

A photograph of a mecha subject: a mechanical structure with an open-front cockpit above two compact articulated walking legs, parked in a quiet outdoor proving yard. In the frame, the mechanical subject is visibly present as a substantial working machine with joints, overlapping plates and worn load-bearing feet. A pilot sits in the cockpit, pausing over a folded route map before setting off. Use the supplied portrait as the pilot's facial and hair appearance reference. Preserve brown eyes and softly rounded facial contours, with a short dark brown bob, wispy separated bangs. Her face has a calm, concentrated presence in the soft daylight. The pilot rests her anatomical LEFT forearm along the left cockpit sill; her anatomical RIGHT hand lies flat on the paper route map. The map rests on her right thigh. The left cockpit sill is a broad horizontal support under the full left forearm. The paper route map shows a route line across its paper surface. The folded sheet has visible paper edges beneath her palm. Seen from the front, her left forearm and sill are on image right, while her right hand, map and right thigh are on image left. Her shoulders, elbows, wrists and fingers form relaxed, traceable chains. The seat supports her pelvis and back, and both boot soles are planted on the shallow open-front cockpit floor, with their sole-to-floor contacts exposed below her knees. The machine's two walking legs are separated in projection from hip joints through knees and ankles to two broad feet resting flat on the yard surface. A low front rim keeps the pilot's boot contacts in view. Frame the complete compact machine from a mildly elevated, almost frontal viewpoint, including the pilot's face, both arm contacts, the cockpit floor, both complete machine legs and both ground contacts together, with a small margin of ground below the feet. Let a 50mm-equivalent photographic view, clear midtone daylight and deep usable focus make the human pause and the machine's weight equally tangible. Her practical sand-colored work suit and the machine's pale worn metal belong to the same restrained, credible field scene.
